copy.title.title:
Faster NDA and lease
review for your team
copy.title.lead: A tool your team can start on right away: contract review, drafting and sources in one place, no IT project.
copy.starting-point.lead: You are the legal team of a retail chain, 4 people. Around 300 lease agreements and NDAs go through you every month, and the previous tool was too complicated for the team to keep using.
copy.starting-point.areas:
Lease agreements | Around 300 contracts a month, most of them lease agreements and NDAs.
NDAs | NDAs keep coming in and each one needs review against your standards.
Contract drafting | Drafts and letters take time the team would rather spend on substantive work.
copy.use-areas.solutions:
Lease agreements | Clause-by-clause review against your standards, so you approve a list of deviations instead of reading every contract.
NDAs | Gaius compares each NDA with your playbook and flags the clauses to change.
Contract drafting | Drafts built on your own templates, also directly in the Word add-in.
copy.team-support.lead: A quick start: a 14-day trial on real matters and short workshops on your documents, with a Legal Engineer to help.
copy.team-support.concerns: The team abandoned the last tool | From the start Gaius does what your team does every day, to its own standard, and we train people on their real matters.
copy.tool-comparison.lead: How a general AI chatbot compares with a Legal AI built for work on legal documents.
copy.tool-comparison.rows:
Legal sources | General knowledge, no current case law | Polish and EU law and case law, with case numbers
Your documents | Uploaded one chat at a time | One base of your documents and templates
Confidentiality | Public cloud outside your control | Private environment, never used for training
Verification | Answers without sources | Every answer links to its basis
copy.security.lead: Gaius is hosted in the European Economic Area and your documents are never used to train models.
